expect.note: T-A39-3 INVERTED this case. It was a declared limitation -- the named extracted-text region sat past MAX_ELEMS and no planner ever saw it -- and the per-control option budget removed the limitation rather than documenting it further. All three must now be present TOGETHER, which is the whole claim: the status line survives, the answer region survives, and the select is still ADVERTISED (a budget that hid the control itself would trade one invisibility for another).

provenance: M41. The postmortem's lesser shape — "the capabilities `<details open>` table competes for the observation's MAX_ELEMS element budget" — measured on the deployed page and found to be worse than predicted, in a different place. The committed-fixture `<select>` contributes 42 `option` elements to the accessibility tree (`/api/meta` `fixtures` list, `git_sha` `6b37ffa99d05`), and with `observe.MAX_ELEMS = 60` the page-level observation ends two sidebar buttons past the status line: the last elements are `status — 'doc_status'`, `button — '1 Business …'`, `button — '1A Risk Factors …'`. The extracted-text region that `sec10k-item-text-region-resolves` proves is reachable is therefore never SHOWN to a planner. This is `observe-cap-hides-the-answer-element` / D27's shape on a real deployed page rather than on `deep-spec.html`. Watched RED first by raising `observe.MAX_ELEMS` from 60 to 200 — see `triage.red_first` for the recorded output. **Build provenance, corrected after cold review — three shas are involved and only two of them are the same thing.** `/api/meta` answered `5a44758598f5` when this milestone started and `6b37ffa99d05` at probe time. But the captured page's own footer — which the page fills from that same `/api/meta` field, one line of its own script — already read `build 6b37ffa99d05` in the FIRST capture, taken while `curl` to the same endpoint was still answering `5a44758598f5`. The two reads disagreed inside one session, which is what a rolling deploy across containers looks like; that explanation is INFERRED, not measured, and is written as an inference on purpose. What is measured: the committed snapshot is a capture of the build that reported itself as `6b37ffa99d05`, which is the same build ADR-030's probe ran against, so the fixture and the probe agree on one build rather than straddling two. The capture was re-taken later, after `/api/meta` had caught up, and diffed against the committed one — identical apart from a single `total_ms` figure inside the extraction evidence (227.6 -> 221.1), which is what that agreement looks like from the other side. The first version of this note claimed the capture was taken at `5a44758598f5`; the page says otherwise and the page is the artifact. Nothing in this repo reads either sha back — `tasks/TODO.md` T-M41-3 is the debt block for that, and D28's build-expiry rule is why it matters. **INVERTED 2026-08-28 (T-A39-3).** Everything above is the state M41 measured and declared; it is kept because the reasoning is still the reasoning, not because the assertion still holds. ADR-039's settle made it acute -- once the committed-fixture select PAINTED, its 49 options crowded the page-level observation so hard that `status — 'doc_status'` fell outside the cap too, which is more than M41 had lost. The fix is the lever this block's own acceptance called untried: a per-CONTROL option sub-budget (`observe.MAX_OPTIONS = 8`, per combobox, the shape `MAX_CHROME` already has per landmark), NOT a raised `MAX_ELEMS`, which this repo has refused twice because it moves the cliff to the next larger page. A drill-down onto the select gets the whole page budget, the same exemption chrome has, so the options a planner actually needs are one `observe` away rather than gone. Measured after: 60 elements, 8 options listed, and all three of `doc_status`, `Item 4 extracted text` and the combobox present. The ID IS NOW STALE and is kept anyway -- two committed reports and five documents cite it by name, and an id that lies about its own conclusion is a smaller cost than citations that resolve to nothing (T-R40 is what the other choice costs).

Its own earlier red-first (MAX_ELEMS raised 60 -> 200) still stands as the record of what the cap-shaped assertion used to prove.
